audience: support teams and helpdesk operators using Vision Helpdesk

useCases.title: Review overdue support tickets
useCases.text: Read dashboard counts, list the overdue folder and open selected tickets to summarize the conversation and current ownership.

useCases.title: Look up a customer before replying
useCases.text: Find a client by name or email, then inspect their summary, notes and ticket counts for context.

useCases.title: Hand off a support ticket
useCases.text: After reviewing the ticket, confirm an internal note, staff assignment or status change to record the handoff.

useCases.title: Find tickets by reference or subject
useCases.text: Search for an exact ticket reference or subject, then read its conversation without scanning the whole inbox.
